name: Lakeland Orchard and Cidery
tagline:
Lakeland Orchard Info
 – Lakeland Orchard & Cidery
description: In Scott Township, PA, Lakeland Orchard and Cidery grows Strawberries, Apples, Squash, Corn, and Tomatoes on a family-run apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. The season runs through spring, autumn, and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
